question:
The following graph shows the sales made by two companies, A and B, over 7 years. Answer the question below based on the graph.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/182840f3c1a22bec487ea9a62bf1c4a7db31c5693936f58e1ec2714dbdf1aa24.png] 

In which year was the difference between the sales made by A and that made by B the least?
solution:
**Given:**

This Graph shows the sales made by two companies, A and B, over 7 years. Answer the question below based on the graph.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/182840f3c1a22bec487ea9a62bf1c4a7db31c5693936f58e1ec2714dbdf1aa24.png] 

**Calculation:**

Difference in sales made by A and made by B in year 2000 = 40 - 20 = 20

Difference in sales made by A and made by B in year 2001 = 60 - 40 = 20

Difference in sales made by A and made by B in year 2002 = 20 - 10 = 10

Difference in sales made by A and made by B in year 2003 = 80 - 70 = 10

Difference in sales made by A and made by B in year 2004 = 50 - 40 = 10

Difference in sales made by A and made by B in year 2005 = 60 - 50 = 10

Difference in sales made by A and made by B in year 2006 = 30 - 30 = 0

**Hence, The difference in sales made by A and made by B is least in year 2006.**
